content.comment_body: Can anyone assist me in locating the link for [product_name] PLC software?

A direct download for the complete version of [product_name] is not available; only a demo can be accessed online. If you already have the full version, you can upgrade it by downloading from [url]: this site provides firmware updates for [product_name] basic devices and the service pack for [product_name] V[version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: A user is searching for online access to the full version of [product_name] but finds only a demo version. Upgrade options exist for current full-version owners, indicating that acquiring the complete software online is limited for new customers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates finding an online direct download link for the full version of [product_name].
